fn_ap_inbox_delivery_storage_after_updat.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ap_inbox_delivery_storage_after_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  retained_bytes_delta BIGINT;
  unverified_rows_delta BIGINT;
  unverified_bytes_delta BIGINT;
  counters ap_inbox_delivery_storage_counters%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(raw_body)) FROM updated_deliveries), 0)
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(raw_body)) FROM previous_deliveries), 0),
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated_deliveries WHERE verified_at IS NULL), 0)
      - COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM previous_deliveries WHERE verified_at IS NULL), 0),
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(raw_body)) FROM updated_deliveries WHERE verified_at IS NULL), 0)
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(raw_body)) FROM previous_deliveries WHERE verified_at IS NULL), 0)
  INTO retained_bytes_delta, unverified_rows_delta, unverified_bytes_delta;

  UPDATE ap_inbox_delivery_storage_counters
  SET retained_raw_body_bytes = retained_raw_body_bytes + retained_bytes_delta,
      unverified_rows = unverified_rows + unverified_rows_delta,
      unverified_raw_body_bytes = unverified_raw_body_bytes + unverified_bytes_delta,
      updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE singleton
    AND (unverified_rows_delta <= 0 OR unverified_rows + unverified_rows_delta <= 10000)
    AND (
      unverified_bytes_delta <= 0
      OR unverified_raw_body_bytes + unverified_bytes_delta <= 268435456
    )
  RETURNING * INTO counters;

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO counters
  FROM ap_inbox_delivery_storage_counters
  WHERE singleton;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '55000',
      MESSAGE = 'ActivityPub inbox storage counter singleton is missing';
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING
    ERRCODE = '23514',
    CONSTRAINT = 'ap_inbox_deliveries_unverified_capacity',
    MESSAGE = 'ActivityPub inbox unverified storage capacity exceeded',
    DETAIL = json_build_object(
      'unverifiedRows', counters.unverified_rows,
      'unverifiedRawBodyBytes', counters.unverified_raw_body_bytes,
      'attemptedRows', unverified_rows_delta,
      'attemptedRawBodyBytes', unverified_bytes_delta
    )::TEXT;
END;
$function$

fn_assert_web_push_endpoint_owner_subscr.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_assert_web_push_endpoint_owner_subscription()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  checked_endpoint_digest BYTEA := COALESCE(NEW.endpoint_digest, OLD.endpoint_digest);
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_push_endpoint_owners owner
    WHERE owner.endpoint_digest = checked_endpoint_digest
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_push_subscriptions subscription
        WHERE subscription.user_id = owner.user_id
          AND subscription.id = owner.subscription_id
          AND subscription.endpoint = owner.endpoint
          AND subscription.deleted_at IS NULL
      )
  ) OR (
    TG_OP <> 'INSERT'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM web_push_subscriptions subscription
      WHERE subscription.user_id = OLD.user_id
        AND subscription.id = OLD.subscription_id
        AND subscription.endpoint = OLD.endpoint
        AND subscription.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_push_endpoint_owners owner
          WHERE owner.endpoint_digest = OLD.endpoint_digest
            AND owner.endpoint = OLD.endpoint
            AND owner.user_id = OLD.user_id
            AND owner.subscription_id = OLD.subscription_id
        )
    )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'web push endpoint owner requires one exact active subscription';
  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

fn_assert_web_push_subscription_owner.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_assert_web_push_subscription_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  checked_user_id UUID := COALESCE(NEW.user_id, OLD.user_id);
  checked_subscription_id UUID := COALESCE(NEW.id, OLD.id);
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_push_subscriptions subscription
    WHERE subscription.user_id = checked_user_id
      AND subscription.id = checked_subscription_id
      AND subscription.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_push_endpoint_owners owner
        WHERE owner.endpoint_digest = digest(subscription.endpoint, 'sha256')
          AND owner.endpoint = subscription.endpoint
          AND owner.user_id = subscription.user_id
          AND owner.subscription_id = subscription.id
      )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active web push subscription requires one exact endpoint owner';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_push_endpoint_owners owner
    WHERE owner.user_id = checked_user_id
      AND owner.subscription_id = checked_subscription_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_push_subscriptions subscription
        WHERE subscription.user_id = owner.user_id
          AND subscription.id = owner.subscription_id
          AND subscription.endpoint = owner.endpoint
          AND subscription.deleted_at IS NULL
      )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'web push endpoint owner requires one exact active subscription';
  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

fn_capture_notification_push_intent.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_capture_notification_push_intent()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    DELETE FROM notification_push_intent_subscription_receipts
    WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id AND notification_id IN (OLD.id, NEW.id);
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO notification_push_intents (user_id, notification_id)
  VALUES (NEW.user_id, NEW.id)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, notification_id) DO UPDATE
  SET status = 'pending',
      lease_token = NULL,
      leased_at = NULL,
      lease_expires_at = NULL,
      suppressed_at = NULL,
      delivered_at = NULL,
      updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

fn_enforce_membership_provider_evidence_.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_enforce_membership_provider_evidence_immutability()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership provider evidence records are immutable';
  END IF;

  IF ROW(
    NEW.id,
    NEW.provider,
    NEW.environment,
    NEW.application_id,
    NEW.provider_event_id,
    NEW.evidence_lookup_sha256,
    NEW.encrypted_evidence,
    NEW.received_at
  ) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(
    OLD.id,
    OLD.provider,
    OLD.environment,
    OLD.application_id,
    OLD.provider_event_id,
    OLD.evidence_lookup_sha256,
    OLD.encrypted_evidence,
    OLD.received_at
  ) OR (
    OLD.membership_provider_lineage_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.membership_provider_lineage_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.membership_provider_lineage_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership provider evidence identity is immutable';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.rejected_at IS NOT NULL
    OR num_nonnulls(NEW.verified_at, NEW.rejected_at) <> 1
    OR (
      OLD.verified_at IS NOT NULL
      AND (NEW.verified_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.rejected_at IS NULL)
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership provider evidence lifecycle is terminal';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

fn_guard_copyright_counter_notice_assess.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_copyright_counter_notice_assessment_target_scope()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM copyright_notice_submission_assessments assessment
    JOIN copyright_notice_submissions submission
      ON submission.id = assessment.copyright_notice_submission_id
    JOIN copyright_notice_targets target
      ON target.id = NEW.copyright_notice_target_id
    WHERE assessment.id = NEW.copyright_notice_submission_assessment_id
      AND submission.kind = 'counter_notice'
      AND target.copyright_notice_id = submission.copyright_notice_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'counter-notice assessments may cover only targets in the same case' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

fn_guard_copyright_notice_submission.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_copyright_notice_submission()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'copyright legal receipt records are retained' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;
  IF OLD.submitted_by_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.submitted_by_user_id IS NULL
    AND ROW(
      OLD.id,
      OLD.copyright_notice_id,
      OLD.kind,
      OLD.received_at,
      OLD.source_kind,
      OLD.body_ciphertext,
      OLD.created_at,
      OLD.updated_at
    ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(
      NEW.id,
      NEW.copyright_notice_id,
      NEW.kind,
      NEW.received_at,
      NEW.source_kind,
      NEW.body_ciphertext,
      NEW.created_at,
      NEW.updated_at
    ) THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'copyright legal receipt records are immutable' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
END;
$function$

fn_guard_membership_grant_mutation.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_membership_grant_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership grants cannot be deleted';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND OLD.revoked_by_id IS NULL
    AND OLD.revocation_reason IS NULL
    AND NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.revoked_by_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.revocation_reason IS NOT NULL
    AND ROW(
      NEW.id, NEW.membership_source_id, NEW.source_kind, NEW.user_id,
      NEW.membership_product_id, NEW.calendar_days, NEW.granted_by_id,
      NEW.issuer_snapshot, NEW.note
    ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(
      OLD.id, OLD.membership_source_id, OLD.source_kind, OLD.user_id,
      OLD.membership_product_id, OLD.calendar_days, OLD.granted_by_id,
      OLD.issuer_snapshot, OLD.note
    )
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership grants only allow a pending-to-revoked lifecycle transition';
END $function$

fn_guard_membership_lineage_binding_muta.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_membership_lineage_binding_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership lineage bindings cannot be deleted';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.released_at IS NULL
    AND OLD.originating_invoice_id IS NULL
    AND NEW.released_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.release_reason IS NULL
    AND NEW.originating_invoice_id IS NOT NULL
    AND ROW(
      NEW.id, NEW.membership_provider_lineage_id, NEW.user_id, NEW.source_kind, NEW.bound_at
    ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(
      OLD.id, OLD.membership_provider_lineage_id, OLD.user_id, OLD.source_kind, OLD.bound_at
    )
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.released_at IS NULL
    AND OLD.release_reason IS NULL
    AND NEW.released_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.release_reason IS NOT NULL
    AND ROW(
      NEW.id, NEW.membership_provider_lineage_id, NEW.user_id, NEW.source_kind, NEW.bound_at,
      NEW.originating_invoice_id
    ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(
      OLD.id, OLD.membership_provider_lineage_id, OLD.user_id, OLD.source_kind, OLD.bound_at,
      OLD.originating_invoice_id
    )
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.released_at IS NOT NULL
    AND OLD.user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.user_id IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = OLD.user_id)
    AND ROW(
      NEW.id, NEW.membership_provider_lineage_id, NEW.source_kind, NEW.bound_at,
      NEW.released_at, NEW.release_reason, NEW.originating_invoice_id
    ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(
      OLD.id, OLD.membership_provider_lineage_id, OLD.source_kind, OLD.bound_at,
      OLD.released_at, OLD.release_reason, OLD.originating_invoice_id
    )
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership lineage bindings only allow release and final-purge transitions';
END $function$

fn_guard_membership_operation_mutation.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_membership_operation_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership operations cannot be deleted';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership operations only allow one terminal lifecycle transition';
  END IF;

  IF ROW(
    NEW.id, NEW.membership_source_id, NEW.membership_provider_lineage_id,
    NEW.membership_lineage_binding_id, NEW.provider, NEW.environment,
    NEW.application_id, NEW.operation_kind, NEW.idempotency_key,
    NEW.qualifying_allocation_minor_units, NEW.currency_code, NEW.period_started_at,
    NEW.period_ends_at, NEW.collision_at, NEW.requested_at
  ) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(
    OLD.id, OLD.membership_source_id, OLD.membership_provider_lineage_id,
    OLD.membership_lineage_binding_id, OLD.provider, OLD.environment,
    OLD.application_id, OLD.operation_kind, OLD.idempotency_key,
    OLD.qualifying_allocation_minor_units, OLD.currency_code, OLD.period_started_at,
    OLD.period_ends_at, OLD.collision_at, OLD.requested_at
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership operations only allow one terminal lifecycle transition';
  END IF;

  IF NEW.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal < OLD.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership operations cannot decrease reconciliation attempts';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.failed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND OLD.execution_claim_token IS NULL
    AND NEW.failed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.execution_claim_token IS NULL
    AND NEW.completed_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.provider_refund_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.provider_refund_id
    AND NEW.remaining_refundable_minor_units <= OLD.remaining_refundable_minor_units
    AND NEW.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal = OLD.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.execution_claim_token IS NULL
    AND NEW.execution_claim_token IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.completed_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.failed_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.provider_refund_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.provider_refund_id
    AND NEW.remaining_refundable_minor_units IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.remaining_refundable_minor_units
    AND (
      NEW.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal = OLD.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal + 1
      OR (
        OLD.operation_kind <> 'administrator_refund'
        AND NEW.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal = OLD.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal
      )
    )
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.execution_claim_token IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.execution_claim_token IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.execution_claim_token
    AND NEW.completed_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.failed_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.remaining_refundable_minor_units IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.remaining_refundable_minor_units
    AND NEW.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal = OLD.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.execution_claim_token IS NOT NULL
    AND OLD.execution_claimed_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    AND NEW.execution_claim_token IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.execution_claim_token IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.execution_claim_token
    AND NEW.execution_claimed_at > OLD.execution_claimed_at
    AND NEW.completed_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.failed_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.provider_refund_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.provider_refund_id
    AND NEW.remaining_refundable_minor_units IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.remaining_refundable_minor_units
    AND (
      NEW.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal = OLD.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal + 1
      OR (
        OLD.operation_kind <> 'administrator_refund'
        AND NEW.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal = OLD.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal
      )
    )
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.execution_claim_token IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.execution_claim_token IS NULL
    AND NEW.completed_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.failed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.remaining_refundable_minor_units IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.remaining_refundable_minor_units
    AND NEW.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal = OLD.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.execution_claim_token IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.execution_claim_token IS NULL
    AND NEW.completed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.failed_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.remaining_refundable_minor_units IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.remaining_refundable_minor_units
    AND NEW.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal = OLD.reconciliation_attempt_ordinal
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership operations only allow claimed provider execution lifecycle transitions';
END $function$

fn_guard_membership_refund_mutation.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_membership_refund_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership refund receipts cannot be deleted';
  END IF;
  IF ROW(NEW.id, NEW.membership_id, NEW.membership_source_id, NEW.user_id,
      NEW.stripe_refund_id, NEW.stripe_charge_id, NEW.amount_minor_units, NEW.currency_code,
      NEW.stripe_event_id, NEW.created_at)
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    ROW(OLD.id, OLD.membership_id, OLD.membership_source_id, OLD.user_id,
      OLD.stripe_refund_id, OLD.stripe_charge_id, OLD.amount_minor_units, OLD.currency_code,
      OLD.stripe_event_id, OLD.created_at) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership refund receipt facts are immutable';
  END IF;
  IF OLD.source = 'stripe_dashboard' AND NEW.source = 'admin'
    AND (OLD.stripe_payment_intent_id IS NULL OR NEW.stripe_payment_intent_id = OLD.stripe_payment_intent_id)
    AND NOT OLD.revoked_access THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF OLD.source = 'admin' AND NEW.source = 'admin'
    AND NOT OLD.revoked_access AND NEW.revoked_access
    AND ROW(NEW.stripe_payment_intent_id, NEW.stripe_idempotency_key,
      NEW.admin_request_fingerprint, NEW.reason, NEW.issued_by_id, NEW.note)
      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
      ROW(OLD.stripe_payment_intent_id, OLD.stripe_idempotency_key,
        OLD.admin_request_fingerprint, OLD.reason, OLD.issued_by_id, OLD.note) THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'membership refund receipts only allow one-way reconciliation or access revocation';
END $function$

fn_guard_review_dispute_subject_snapshot.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_review_dispute_subject_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.post_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.post_id
    OR OLD.topic_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.topic_id
    OR OLD.disputed_rating IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.disputed_rating THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'review dispute subject snapshot cannot change'
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

fn_guard_review_succession_mutation.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_review_succession_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF ROW(
    NEW.id,
    NEW.predecessor_post_id,
    NEW.successor_post_id,
    NEW.author_user_id,
    NEW.topic_ids,
    NEW.predecessor_archived_at
  ) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(
    OLD.id,
    OLD.predecessor_post_id,
    OLD.successor_post_id,
    OLD.author_user_id,
    OLD.topic_ids,
    OLD.predecessor_archived_at
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'review succession identity and archive epoch are immutable';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.automatically_restored_at IS NULL
    AND OLD.manual_override_at IS NULL
    AND (
      (NEW.automatically_restored_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.manual_override_at IS NULL)
      OR (NEW.automatically_restored_at IS NULL AND NEW.manual_override_at IS NOT NULL)
    )
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'review succession only allows one terminal lifecycle transition';
END;
$function$

fn_moderation_transparency_actions_delet.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_moderation_transparency_actions_delete_rollup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE cohort record;
BEGIN
  FOR cohort IN
    SELECT (uuid_extract_timestamp(id) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day,
      NULL::uuid AS community_id, 'moderation_actions'::text AS metric,
      action_type::text AS category, count(*)::integer AS count

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_protect_agent_moderation_transparency_projection()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id
    OR OLD.agent_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.agent_id
    OR OLD.prompt_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.prompt_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'agent moderation transparency source identity is immutable';
  END IF;
  IF OLD.deleted_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.deleted_at
    AND (OLD.moderation_transparency_category IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.moderation_transparency_category
      OR OLD.moderation_transparency_community_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.moderation_transparency_community_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'agent moderation transparency projection is trigger-maintained';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

fn_release_moderation_transparency_daily.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_release_moderation_transparency_daily_rollup(p_day date, p_community_id uuid, p_metric text, p_category text, p_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Share the same per-cohort lock as source-triggered increments and decrements.
  -- A release must snapshot and remove a candidate atomically with respect to a
  -- source lifecycle mutation, otherwise an old write could recreate it.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
    'moderation-transparency-rollup:' || p_day::text || ':'
      || COALESCE(p_community_id::text, 'global') || ':' || p_metric || ':' || p_category,
    0
  ));
  INSERT INTO moderation_transparency_released_daily_rollups(
    day, community_id, metric, category, count, latest_occurred_at
  )
  SELECT day, community_id, metric, category, count, latest_occurred_at
  FROM moderation_transparency_daily_rollups
  WHERE day = p_day AND community_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_community_id
    AND metric = p_metric AND category = p_category
    AND count >= 20 AND latest_occurred_at <= p_cutoff
  ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT moderation_transparency_released_daily_rollups_key DO NOTHING
  ;
  DELETE FROM moderation_transparency_daily_rollups
  WHERE day = p_day AND community_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_community_id
    AND metric = p_metric AND category = p_category
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM moderation_transparency_released_daily_rollups
      WHERE day = p_day AND community_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_community_id
        AND metric = p_metric AND category = p_category
    );
END $function$

fn_release_next_moderation_transparency_.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_release_next_moderation_transparency_daily_rollup(p_community_id uuid, p_before date, p_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE candidate record;
BEGIN
  IF p_community_id IS NULL THEN
    SELECT day, community_id, metric, category INTO candidate
    FROM moderation_transparency_daily_rollups
    WHERE community_id IS NULL AND day < p_before
      AND count >= 20 AND latest_occurred_at <= p_cutoff
    ORDER BY day DESC
    LIMIT 1;
  ELSE
    SELECT day, community_id, metric, category INTO candidate
    FROM moderation_transparency_daily_rollups
    WHERE community_id = p_community_id AND day < p_before
      AND count >= 20 AND latest_occurred_at <= p_cutoff
    ORDER BY day DESC
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  IF FOUND THEN
    PERFORM fn_release_moderation_transparency_daily_rollup(
      candidate.day, candidate.community_id, candidate.metric, candidate.category, p_cutoff
    );
  END IF;
END $function$

fn_require_classifier_candidate_communit.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_require_classifier_candidate_community_override_lifecycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
    OR NEW.community_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.community_id
    OR NEW.candidate_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.candidate_id
    OR NEW.enabled_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.enabled_at
    OR (
      NEW.enabled_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.enabled_by_id
      AND NOT (
        NEW.enabled_by_id IS NULL
        AND fn_classifier_audit_actor_was_deleted(OLD.enabled_by_id)
      )
    )
    OR NOT (
      NEW.disabled_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.disabled_at
      OR (OLD.disabled_at IS NULL AND NEW.disabled_at IS NOT NULL)
    )
    OR (
      NEW.disabled_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.disabled_by_id
      AND NOT (
        OLD.disabled_at IS NULL AND NEW.disabled_at IS NOT NULL
        OR (
          NEW.disabled_by_id IS NULL
          AND fn_classifier_audit_actor_was_deleted(OLD.disabled_by_id)
        )
      )
    ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'classifier candidate community override is immutable except for deactivation' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

fn_require_classifier_candidate_threshol.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_require_classifier_candidate_threshold_lifecycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
    OR NEW.classifier_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.classifier_id
    OR NEW.candidate_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.candidate_id
    OR NEW.prompt_version_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.prompt_version_id
    OR NEW.lower_threshold_override IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.lower_threshold_override
    OR NEW.upper_threshold_override IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.upper_threshold_override
    OR NEW.activated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.activated_at
    OR (
      NEW.created_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by_id
      AND NOT (
        NEW.created_by_id IS NULL
        AND fn_classifier_audit_actor_was_deleted(OLD.created_by_id)
      )
    )
    OR NOT (
      NEW.deactivated_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.deactivated_at
      OR (OLD.deactivated_at IS NULL AND NEW.deactivated_at IS NOT NULL)
    )
    OR (
      NEW.deactivated_by_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.deactivated_by_id
      AND NOT (
        OLD.deactivated_at IS NULL AND NEW.deactivated_at IS NOT NULL
        OR (
          NEW.deactivated_by_id IS NULL
          AND fn_classifier_audit_actor_was_deleted(OLD.deactivated_by_id)
        )
      )
    ) THEN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_require_mipr_case_op_context()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  valid_context BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
  SELECT operation.operation_kind = 'ineligible_purchase_reversal'
    AND operation.membership_source_id = reversal_case.membership_source_id
    AND operation.membership_provider_lineage_id = reversal_case.membership_provider_lineage_id
    AND operation.membership_lineage_binding_id = reversal_case.membership_lineage_binding_id
  INTO valid_context
  FROM membership_operations operation
  CROSS JOIN membership_ineligible_purchase_reversal_cases reversal_case
  WHERE operation.id = NEW.membership_operation_id
    AND reversal_case.id = NEW.membership_ineligible_purchase_reversal_case_id;

  IF valid_context = FALSE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reversal case operation context does not match its immutable case'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

fn_user_deletion_has_remaining_owned_dat.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_user_deletion_has_remaining_owned_data(target_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  ownership RECORD;
  has_rows BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
  FOR ownership IN
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
      ('posts', 'created_by_id'),
      ('post_topic_alias_sources', 'contributor_id'),
      ('user_email_addresses', 'user_id'),
      ('user_phone_numbers', 'user_id'),
      ('user_passkeys', 'user_id'),
      ('user_totp_authenticators', 'user_id'),
      ('api_keys', 'user_id'),
      ('user_sessions', 'user_id'),
      ('facebook_accounts', 'user_id'),
      ('apple_accounts', 'user_id'),
      ('google_accounts', 'user_id'),
      ('x_accounts', 'user_id'),
      ('linkedin_accounts', 'user_id'),
      ('microsoft_accounts', 'user_id'),
      ('github_accounts', 'user_id'),
      ('bluesky_link_completions', 'user_id'),
      ('bluesky_linked_accounts', 'user_id'),
      ('session_referral_attributions', 'user_id')
    ) AS configured(table_name, column_name)
  LOOP
    EXECUTE format(
      'SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM %I WHERE %I = $1)',
      ownership.table_name,
      ownership.column_name
    ) INTO has_rows USING target_user_id;
    IF has_rows THEN RETURN TRUE; END IF;
  END LOOP;

  FOR ownership IN
    SELECT DISTINCT table_name, 'user_id' AS column_name
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND column_name = 'user_id'
      AND table_name LIKE '%\_votes' ESCAPE '\'
  LOOP
    EXECUTE format(
      'SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM %I WHERE user_id = $1)',
      ownership.table_name
    ) INTO has_rows USING target_user_id;
    IF has_rows THEN RETURN TRUE; END IF;
  END LOOP;

  FOR ownership IN
    SELECT DISTINCT table_name, 'subject_id' AS column_name
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND column_name = 'subject_id'
      AND table_name LIKE 'relation\_\_user\_\_%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND table_name NOT LIKE '%\_votes' ESCAPE '\'
  LOOP
    EXECUTE format(
      'SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM %I WHERE subject_id = $1)',
      ownership.table_name
    ) INTO has_rows USING target_user_id;
    IF has_rows THEN RETURN TRUE; END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM lists WHERE owner_user_id = target_user_id AND removed_at IS NULL
  ) THEN RETURN TRUE; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bluesky_link_authorizations
    WHERE user_id = target_user_id
      AND status IN ('pending', 'callback_claimed', 'handoff_ready', 'attached')
  ) THEN RETURN TRUE; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bluesky_follow_records
    WHERE follower_user_id = target_user_id OR followee_user_id = target_user_id
  ) THEN RETURN TRUE; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM user_data_requests
    WHERE user_id = target_user_id
      AND (
        (completed_at IS NULL AND failed_at IS NULL)
        OR (completed_at IS NOT NULL AND failed_at IS NULL AND s3_key IS NOT NULL)
      )
  ) THEN RETURN TRUE; END IF;
  RETURN FALSE;
END;
$function$

fn_wilson_score_lower_bound(pos double p.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_wilson_score_lower_bound(pos double precision, tot double precision)
 RETURNS double precision
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN tot IS NULL OR tot <= 0 THEN 0
    ELSE
      (
        (pos/tot + (1.96*1.96)/(2*tot))
        - 1.96 * sqrt(((pos/tot) * (1 - (pos/tot)) + (1.96*1.96)/(4*tot)) / tot)
      )
      / (1 + (1.96*1.96)/tot)
  END
$function$

repair_post_category_finalization_admiss.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.repair_post_category_finalization_admission_response_on_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  finalized_topics JSONB;
BEGIN
  -- A posts cascade has no replayable post response to repair. Every ordinary acknowledgement
  -- reaches the update below.
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE id = OLD.post_id) THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(TO_JSONB(topic.*) ORDER BY selected.votes_score_net DESC, selected.object_id),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO finalized_topics
  FROM (
    SELECT relation.object_id, relation.votes_score_net
    FROM relation__post__category__topic relation
    WHERE relation.subject_id = OLD.post_id
      AND OLD.admission_response_generation = OLD.generation
      AND relation.object_id = ANY(OLD.admission_response_topic_ids)
      AND relation.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND relation.votes_score_net > 0
    ORDER BY relation.votes_score_net DESC, relation.object_id
    LIMIT 5
  ) selected
  INNER JOIN view_embedded_topics topic ON topic.id = selected.object_id;

  UPDATE post_admission_reservations
  SET response = CASE
        WHEN OLD.admission_response_generation = OLD.generation
          AND OLD.admission_response_topic_ids IS NOT NULL
        THEN CASE
          WHEN jsonb_typeof(response) = 'object'
            AND jsonb_typeof(response->'post') = 'object'
          THEN jsonb_set(response, '{post,post_related_topics}', finalized_topics)
          WHEN jsonb_typeof(response) = 'object'
          THEN jsonb_set(response, '{post_related_topics}', finalized_topics)
          ELSE response
        END
        ELSE response
      END,
      replay_metadata = replay_metadata || '{"finalization":"complete"}'::jsonb,
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE committed_post_id = OLD.post_id
    AND state = 'committed'
    AND retention_expires_at > NOW();

  RETURN OLD;
END;
$function$

is_baseline.comment: When true, this moderator runs on every approved post regardless of community opt-in (baseline safety net).

on_flag_action.comment: Action taken when a moderator flags content: none (log only) or review_queue (move to review queue).

slug.comment: Unique lowercase identifier for this moderator (e.g. spam-filter).

agents__moderators.comment: Moderator-specific configuration extending the agents table.

ai_usage_record_id.comment: The one ai_usage_records row reserved for this OpenAI response id.

response_id.comment: OpenAI Responses API response id; the primary key prevents duplicate ledger rows across UUIDv7 ledger partitions.

ai_usage_openai_response_keys.comment: Global idempotency map from an OpenAI Responses API response id to its single partitioned ai_usage_records row.

ai_usage_openai_response_keys_ai_usage_r.definition: FOREIGN KEY (ai_usage_record_id) REFERENCES ai_usage_records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ai_usage_openai_response_keys_ai_usage_record_id_key ON public.ai_usage_openai_response_keys USING btree (ai_usage_record_id)

ai_usage_openai_response_keys_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ai_usage_openai_response_keys_pkey ON public.ai_usage_openai_response_keys USING btree (response_id)

checkConstraints.ai_usage_records_check: CHECK ((((pricing_status = 'priced'::text) AND (cost_microunits IS NOT NULL) AND (currency_code IS NOT NULL)) OR ((pricing_status = 'unpriced'::text) AND (cost_microunits IS NULL) AND (currency_code IS NULL))))

agent_slug.comment: The slug of the agent that made the LLM call (a moderator, or another agent workload identifier).

cached_input_tokens.comment: Of input_tokens, the number served from the prompt cache at the discounted cached-input rate.

community_id.comment: The community the call is scoped to, if any; NULL for agents that run outside a community (chat, autotagger, customer-support, ...).

cost_microunits.comment: Estimated cost in millionths of the major currency unit; NULL when unpriced.

currency_code.comment: Currency of the estimated cost; NULL when unpriced.

input_tokens.comment: Number of input tokens billed for this call, including any cached_input_tokens.

model.comment: The OpenAI model actually served, from the response (e.g. gpt-5.4-nano-2026-03-17) — not necessarily the requested alias.

output_tokens.comment: Number of output tokens billed for this call.

post_id.comment: The post that was moderated; nullable if the post has been deleted or the call was not post-scoped.

pricing_status.comment: Whether pricing was known when this usage record was written.

service_tier.comment: The OpenAI service tier actually served, from the response (e.g. flex, default) — not necessarily the requested tier.

ai_usage_records.comment: Append-only per-call LLM usage and cost ledger for every agent that calls OpenAI, not only community moderation.

ai_usage_records_community_id_fkey.definition: FOREIGN KEY (community_id) REFERENCES communities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

ai_usage_records_currency_code_fkey.definition: FOREIGN KEY (currency_code) REFERENCES currencies(code) ON DELETE RESTRICT

ai_usage_records_post_id_fkey.definition: FOREIGN KEY (post_id) REFERENCES posts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

key_id.comment: The public keyId URI advertised on the actor document and used in the HTTP Signature keyId parameter, e.g. https://host/ap/users/:userId#main-key.

private_key_ciphertext.comment: AES-256-GCM ciphertext (via @modules/token-secrets encryptSecret, purpose ap:actor-key:<userId>) of the PEM-encoded RSA private key. Never store or log the plaintext PEM.

public_key_pem.comment: PEM-encoded RSA public key, published on the actor document for remote signature verification.

user_id.comment: The local user this actor keypair belongs to. One keypair per federated user.

ap_actor_keys.comment: RSA signing keypair for a local user's ActivityPub actor (/ap/users/:userId). Private key is encrypted at rest; only ever decrypted in-process to sign outbound HTTP Signatures.

ap_actor_keys_user_id_fkey.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

ap_actor_keys_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ap_actor_keys_pkey ON public.ap_actor_keys USING btree (user_id)

idx_ap_actor_keys__key_id.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ap_actor_keys__key_id ON public.ap_actor_keys USING btree (key_id)

activity_id.comment: The ActivityPub activity's `id` field (a remote URI). Unique — the dedup key.

activity_type.comment: The activity's `type` field (e.g. Follow, Undo, Like), recorded for operational visibility.

actor_uri.comment: The activity's `actor` field (the sending remote actor's ActivityPub id), recorded for operational visibility.

received_at.comment: When this activity was accepted by the inbox receiver.

ap_inbox_activities.comment: Replay-dedup ledger for the ActivityPub inbox receiver. The marker commits atomically with the activity core database effect; a second delivery of the same activity id is rejected before it reaches any write-path.

ap_inbox_activities_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ap_inbox_activities_pkey ON public.ap_inbox_activities USING btree (id)

checkConstraints.ap_inbox_deliveries__deferral_state_vali: CHECK (((deferred_until IS NULL) OR ((verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (remote_actor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (processing_at IS NULL) AND (enqueued_at IS NULL) AND (sender_allowed_at IS NULL) AND (failed_at IS NULL) AND (last_error IS NOT NULL))))
checkConstraints.ap_inbox_deliveries__failed_requires_fir: CHECK (((failed_at IS NULL) OR (first_failed_at IS NOT NULL)))
checkConstraints.ap_inbox_deliveries__failure_state_valid: CHECK (((failed_at IS NULL) OR ((processing_at IS NOT NULL) AND (deferred_until IS NULL) AND (last_error IS NOT NULL))))
checkConstraints.ap_inbox_deliveries__first_failed_requir: CHECK (((first_failed_at IS NULL) OR (retention_expires_at IS NOT NULL)))
checkConstraints.ap_inbox_deliveries__sender_admission_re: CHECK (((sender_allowed_at IS NULL) OR ((verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (remote_actor_id IS NOT NULL))))
checkConstraints.ap_inbox_deliveries__terminal_diagnostic: CHECK ((((deferred_until IS NULL) AND (failed_at IS NULL)) OR (last_error IS NOT NULL)))
checkConstraints.ap_inbox_deliveries__unverified_requires: CHECK (((verified_at IS NOT NULL) OR (retention_expires_at IS NOT NULL)))
checkConstraints.ap_inbox_deliveries__verified_failure_re: CHECK (((verified_at IS NULL) OR (first_failed_at IS NULL) OR (retention_expires_at <= (first_failed_at + '7 days'::interval))))
checkConstraints.ap_inbox_deliveries__verified_never_fail: CHECK (((verified_at IS NULL) OR (first_failed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (retention_expires_at IS NULL)))

claimed_activity_id.comment: Untrusted activity id parsed before signature verification. Intentionally not unique so an unsigned request cannot squat a legitimate id.

claimed_activity_type.comment: Untrusted activity type parsed during the network-free request preflight.

claimed_actor_uri.comment: Untrusted activity actor URI parsed during the network-free request preflight.

content_type_header.comment: Optional exact Content-Type header for senders that include it in their signed headers.

date_header.comment: Exact inbound Date header evaluated relative to received_at during queued verification.

deferred_until.comment: Earliest retry time after a valid sender exceeds its hostname delivery allowance.

digest_header.comment: Exact inbound Digest header binding the signature to raw_body.

enqueued_at.comment: Latest dispatch lease timestamp; recovery waits five minutes before replacing a missing queue job.

expected_host.comment: Public Host value covered by the sender's HTTP Signature.

failed_at.comment: Set only after the queue exhausts retryable operational attempts. Manual backfill clears it and rotates the fencing token.

first_failed_at.comment: Immutable timestamp of the first retry-exhausting operational failure; survives rearm to anchor sticky retention.

last_error.comment: Latest bounded operational failure message for recovery and operator diagnostics.

processing_at.comment: Active worker lease timestamp; non-final retryable failures release it and stale crashes recover after thirty minutes.

processing_attempt_id.comment: Fencing token rotated whenever recovery re-enqueues the delivery; stale queue jobs cannot process the row.

raw_body.comment: Exact inbound request bytes, bounded to 1 MiB and deleted after a final protocol outcome.

received_at.comment: When the API durably accepted the unverified envelope.

remote_actor_id.comment: Verified signing actor checkpoint. Actor deletion is restricted while the durable delivery remains.

request_method.comment: Uppercase HTTP method from the exact inbound signed request; bounded to 16 characters.

request_target.comment: Exact path and query string used to reconstruct the signed (request-target) value.

retention_expires_at.comment: Maximum retention deadline for an unverified or previously failed durable delivery.

sender_allowed_at.comment: Set after the sender-hostname delivery rate limit admits this envelope; retries do not charge the sender again.

sender_hostname.comment: Lowercase hostname derived from the unverified Signature keyId and revalidated by the worker.

signature_header.comment: Exact inbound Signature header retained until verification reaches a final outcome.

verified_at.comment: When the worker first verified the exact request signature and actor match; always paired with remote_actor_id.

ap_inbox_deliveries.comment: Durable, unverified ActivityPub inbox envelopes awaiting worker verification and dispatch. Rows and raw request bytes are deleted after a final protocol outcome.

ap_inbox_deliveries_remote_actor_id_fkey.definition: FOREIGN KEY (remote_actor_id) REFERENCES remote_actors(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

ap_inbox_deliveries_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ap_inbox_deliveries_pkey ON public.ap_inbox_deliveries USING btree (id)

idx_ap_inbox_deliveries__recovery.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_ap_inbox_deliveries__recovery ON public.ap_inbox_deliveries USING btree (failed_at, deferred_until, processing_at, enqueued_at, received_at, id)

idx_ap_inbox_deliveries__remote_actor_id.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_ap_inbox_deliveries__remote_actor_id ON public.ap_inbox_deliveries USING btree (remote_actor_id) WHERE (remote_actor_id IS NOT NULL)

idx_ap_inbox_deliveries__unverified_rete.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_ap_inbox_deliveries__unverified_retention ON public.ap_inbox_deliveries USING btree (retention_expires_at, id) WHERE ((verified_at IS NULL) AND (retention_expires_at IS NOT NULL))
idx_ap_inbox_deliveries__unverified_rete.predicate: ((verified_at IS NULL) AND (retention_expires_at IS NOT NULL))

idx_ap_inbox_deliveries__verified_retent.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_ap_inbox_deliveries__verified_retention ON public.ap_inbox_deliveries USING btree (retention_expires_at, id) WHERE ((verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (retention_expires_at IS NOT NULL))
idx_ap_inbox_deliveries__verified_retent.predicate: ((verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (retention_expires_at IS NOT NULL))

retained_raw_body_bytes.comment: Exact sum of raw request-body bytes across all retained ActivityPub inbox deliveries.

retained_rows.comment: Exact number of all durable ActivityPub inbox delivery rows currently retained.

singleton.comment: Always true; enforces the ledger has at most one aggregate row.

unverified_raw_body_bytes.comment: Exact sum of raw request-body bytes across retained unverified ActivityPub inbox deliveries.

unverified_rows.comment: Exact number of retained ActivityPub inbox deliveries that have not been verified.

ap_inbox_delivery_storage_counters.comment: Transactionally maintained singleton ledger for retained and unverified ActivityPub inbox row and raw-body byte totals.

ap_inbox_delivery_storage_counters_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ap_inbox_delivery_storage_counters_pkey ON public.ap_inbox_delivery_storage_counters USING btree (singleton)

deleted_at.comment: Set by an inbound Undo(Like). NULL while the like is active. A later re-Like from the same (post_id, remote_actor_id) resurrects this same row rather than inserting a new one — see fn_sync_ap_post_likes.

like_ap_id.comment: The inbound Like activity's ActivityPub `id`. Unique while active — a second live Like from the same remote actor on the same post is rejected by idx_ap_post_likes__post_remote_actor before this could collide.

post_id.comment: The local post that was liked.

remote_actor_id.comment: The remote actor who sent the Like. One active row per (post_id, remote_actor_id) — see idx_ap_post_likes__post_remote_actor.

ap_post_likes.comment: Append-only ledger of remote ActivityPub Like/Undo(Like) activity against local posts. FKs post_id directly (not ap_posts) so writes never depend on ap_posts row-creation order; the sync trigger below lazily creates it.

ap_post_likes_post_id_fkey.definition: FOREIGN KEY (post_id) REFERENCES posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

ap_post_likes_remote_actor_id_fkey.definition: FOREIGN KEY (remote_actor_id) REFERENCES remote_actors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

ap_post_likes_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ap_post_likes_pkey ON public.ap_post_likes USING btree (id)

idx_ap_post_likes__like_ap_id.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ap_post_likes__like_ap_id ON public.ap_post_likes USING btree (like_ap_id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)

idx_ap_post_likes__post_id.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_ap_post_likes__post_id ON public.ap_post_likes USING btree (post_id)

idx_ap_post_likes__post_remote_actor.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ap_post_likes__post_remote_actor ON public.ap_post_likes USING btree (post_id, remote_actor_id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)

idx_ap_post_likes__remote_actor_id.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_ap_post_likes__remote_actor_id ON public.ap_post_likes USING btree (remote_actor_id)

triggers.trigger_sync_ap_post_likes: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_sync_ap_post_likes AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.ap_post_likes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_sync_ap_post_likes()

ap_likes_count.comment: Same value as ap_likes_score, stored separately as a plain display count in case score gains per-actor weighting later.

ap_likes_score.comment: COUNT of active (non-Undo'd) ap_post_likes rows for this post. DOUBLE PRECISION to match the shape of other score columns even though every Like currently weighs 1.

post_id.comment: The local post this tally is for (1:1, lazily created on first remote like).

ap_posts.comment: AP-only like tally per post, trigger-maintained from ap_post_likes. Isolated from post_votes — remote likes never affect local ranking.

ap_posts_post_id_fkey.definition: FOREIGN KEY (post_id) REFERENCES posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

ap_posts_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ap_posts_pkey ON public.ap_posts USING btree (post_id)

key_hash.comment: SHA-256 hash of the full API key (32 bytes).

label.comment: User-provided label to identify the key's purpose.

last_used_at.comment: When this API key was last used for authentication.

permissions.comment: Canonical scope set granted to this key; validated against the application scope catalogue.

prefix.comment: Visible prefix of the API key for identification (e.g. voucha_rss_XXXX, 8-16 chars).

revoked_at.comment: When this API key was revoked; revoked keys cannot authenticate.

type.comment: Key type scope (rss or mcp). Determines which API features the key can access.

user_id.comment: The user who owns this API key.

api_keys.comment: User-issued API keys for programmatic access (format: voucha_<type>_<32 hex random>_<16 hex checksum>), stored as SHA-256 hashes.

api_keys_user_id_fkey.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

ai_generated_at.comment: When the AI draft was generated.

ai_prompt.comment: The prompt used to generate this message draft, if AI-assisted.

approved_at.comment: Set when an admin approves the draft for sending.

approved_by_id.comment: The admin who approved the draft.

body_html.comment: HTML message body. Used for email-channel messages.

body_text.comment: Plain text message body. Used for email-channel messages.

bounced_at.comment: When a bounce notification was received.

content.comment: Message content stored as JSONB. Used for chat messages.

conversation_id.comment: The conversation this message belongs to; also the partition key.

created_by_id.comment: The registered user who sent this message. Mutually exclusive with support_contact_id.

crm_contact_id.comment: The CRM contact who sent this message. Mutually exclusive with created_by_id and support_contact_id.

delivered_at.comment: When delivery was confirmed by the provider.

direction.comment: Email/note direction. inbound = external contact, outbound = internal/admin authored.

discarded_at.comment: When a draft was discarded. Mutually exclusive with sent_at.

drafted_at.comment: Set when message was AI-generated as a draft. NULL until admin approves and sends.

edited_at.comment: When the draft was last edited by a human.

edited_by_id.comment: The user who last edited the draft.

email_message_id.comment: Email Message-ID header for threading inbound replies.

email_provider.comment: Email provider used for email-channel messages.

kind.comment: Message kind: chat, email, or internal note.

received_at.comment: When an inbound message was received.

sent_at.comment: Set when the message is actually sent to the recipient.

support_contact_id.comment: The email-identified support contact who sent this message. Mutually exclusive with created_by_id.

conversation_messages.comment: Individual messages within a conversation, range-partitioned by conversation UUIDv7. Chat messages use content JSONB; email-channel messages use body_text/body_html.

assigned_at.comment: When this modmail thread was assigned to assigned_mod_id.

subject_user_id.comment: The user who is the subject of a modmail thread. Required when channel_type is modmail.

actor_label.comment: Optional display label for the actor who triggered the notification.

actor_user_id.comment: The user who performed the action triggering this notification. For follow: the follower. For referral_signup: the newly signed-up user (not the referrer). Required for follow and referral_signup types.

community_ban_id.comment: The community ban this notification refers to; set when entity_type is community_ban.

community_id.comment: Community associated with a community lifecycle notification.

conversation_id.comment: The conversation this notification refers to; set when entity_type is direct_message or modmail.

delete_reason.comment: Why this notification was deleted: system_pruned or user_deleted.

delivery_type.comment: How the notification was triggered: subscription (automatic) or manual_send.

entity_type.comment: The type of entity this notification is about: post, rss_feed_item, follow, referral_signup, moderation_report, review_dispute, or user_warning.

event_key.comment: Stable producer-defined idempotency key, unique per recipient even after dismissal.

moderation_appeal_id.comment: The moderation appeal this notification refers to; set when entity_type is moderation_appeal.

moderation_report_id.comment: Moderation report this notification refers to; set when entity_type is moderation_report.

post_id.comment: The post this notification refers to; set when entity_type is post.

publication_post_id.comment: Stable post target retained after the display FK is cleared by hard deletion, for publication reconciliation only.

publication_rss_feed_item_id.comment: Stable RSS item target retained after the display FK is cleared by hard deletion, for publication reconciliation only.

pushed_at.comment: When a push notification was sent for this notification.

read_at.comment: When the user read this notification.

review_dispute_id.comment: The review dispute this notification refers to; set when entity_type is review_dispute.

rss_feed_item_id.comment: The RSS feed item this notification refers to; set when entity_type is rss_feed_item.

sent_by_user_id.comment: The user who manually sent this notification; set when delivery_type is manual_send.

target_entity.comment: Structured entity navigation target; preferred over the legacy target_path.

target_intent.comment: Structured application navigation intent; preferred over the legacy target_path.

target_path.comment: URL path the notification links to.

user_id.comment: The user receiving this notification; also the partition key.

user_warning_id.comment: The user warning this notification refers to; set when entity_type is user_warning.

notifications.comment: User notifications for posts and RSS feed items, range-partitioned by user UUIDv7.

checkConstraints.oauth_authorization_server_events_check2: CHECK ((((event_type = 'consent_denied'::text) AND (grant_id IS NULL)) OR ((event_type <> 'consent_denied'::text) AND (grant_id IS NOT NULL))))

access_token_id.comment: Short-lived access token affected by a revocation event; intentionally not a foreign key.

authorization_request_id.comment: Short-lived authorization request that produced a consent event; intentionally not a foreign key.

client_id.comment: Client internal identifier at event time; intentionally not a foreign key so client deletion preserves the audit record.

event_type.comment: Immutable consent, explicit revocation, or refresh-reuse lifecycle outcome.

grant_id.comment: Grant internal identifier at event time; intentionally not a foreign key so grant deletion preserves the audit record.

occurred_at.comment: UUIDv7-derived time at which the event was recorded.

refresh_token_family_id.comment: Short-lived refresh family affected by revocation or reuse; intentionally not a foreign key.

resource.comment: Protected resource audience affected by the event.

scopes.comment: Canonical scope set affected by the event.

user_id.comment: Grant owner at event time; intentionally not a foreign key so hard deletion preserves the audit record.

oauth_authorization_server_events.comment: Append-only durable evidence of OAuth consent and token revocation lifecycle events; identity columns intentionally have no foreign keys so retention and identity deletion cannot erase the audit record.

checkConstraints.oauth_authorizations_check: CHECK ((((purpose = 'authenticate'::text) AND (initiating_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((purpose = 'connect'::text) AND (initiating_user_id IS NOT NULL))))
checkConstraints.oauth_authorizations_check1: CHECK ((((callback_mode = 'native'::text) AND (completion_proof_challenge ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$'::text)) OR ((callback_mode = 'web'::text) AND (completion_proof_challenge IS NULL))))
checkConstraints.oauth_authorizations_check3: CHECK ((((provider = 'facebook'::text) AND (x_user_id IS NULL) AND (github_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((provider = 'x'::text) AND (facebook_user_id IS NULL) AND (github_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((provider = 'github'::text) AND (facebook_user_id IS NULL) AND (x_user_id IS NULL))))
checkConstraints.oauth_authorizations_check4: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['callback_received'::text, 'exchanging'::text, 'completion_ready'::text, 'completed'::text])) OR (callback_received_at IS NOT NULL)))
checkConstraints.oauth_authorizations_check5: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['completion_ready'::text, 'completed'::text])) OR ((completion_ready_at IS NOT NULL) AND (callback_code_ciphertext IS NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(facebook_user_id, x_user_id, github_user_id) = 1))))
checkConstraints.oauth_authorizations_check6: CHECK ((((status <> 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NULL) AND (result_kind IS NULL) AND (result_user_id IS NULL) AND (result_device_id IS NULL) AND (result_session_id IS NULL) AND (login_attempt_id IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (result_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (((result_kind = 'authenticated'::text) AND (result_device_id IS NOT NULL) AND (uuid_extract_version(result_device_id) = 7) AND (result_session_id IS NOT NULL) AND (uuid_extract_version(result_session_id) = 7) AND (login_attempt_id IS NULL)) OR ((result_kind = 'mfa_required'::text) AND (result_device_id IS NULL) AND (result_session_id IS NULL) AND (login_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (uuid_extract_version(login_attempt_id) = 7)) OR ((result_kind = 'connected'::text) AND (result_device_id IS NULL) AND (result_session_id IS NULL) AND (login_attempt_id IS NULL))))))

callback_code_ciphertext.comment: Authenticated ciphertext of the one-time provider code; cleared only after durable provider-account persistence.

callback_error.comment: Bounded provider callback or terminal exchange error code; never contains provider credentials.

callback_mode.comment: web uses an HttpOnly completion cookie; native uses a bearer token plus the app-held proof verifier.

callback_received_at.comment: When the provider callback first durably persisted a code or denial.

completed_at.comment: When a caller first consumed and finalized the durable completion result.

completion_proof_challenge.comment: Native-only base64url SHA-256 challenge for the app-held completion verifier.

completion_ready_at.comment: When provider identity persistence completed and the result became consumable.

completion_token_ciphertext.comment: Authenticated ciphertext of the completion token retained only so a repeated provider callback converges on the same handoff.

completion_token_hash.comment: Purpose-bound HMAC-SHA256 of the web cookie or native callback bearer token.

exchange_attempts.comment: Durable count of claimed provider exchange attempts for reconciliation and operator diagnosis.

exchange_claim_id.comment: Fencing token for one worker exchange attempt; atomic provider-account completion must present the current claim.

exchange_started_at.comment: When the current fenced provider exchange claim began.

expires_at.comment: Authorization deadline; cleanup and recovery use this timestamp rather than UUID ordering.

facebook_user_id.comment: Facebook account produced by a successful exchange; parent deletion cascades the authorization.

github_user_id.comment: GitHub account produced by a successful exchange; parent deletion cascades the authorization.

initiating_device_id.comment: Device JWT identifier that must still match when completion is consumed.

initiating_session_id.comment: Session JWT identifier that must still match when completion is consumed.

initiating_user_id.comment: Required owner for connect flows and NULL for authenticate flows.

login_attempt_id.comment: UUIDv7 MFA attempt identifier returned only for an mfa_required result.

pkce_verifier_ciphertext.comment: Authenticated ciphertext of the server-generated provider PKCE verifier.

provider.comment: Provider selected at begin time; callback and completion derive it only from this durable record.

purpose.comment: authenticate creates or resumes a Voucha session; connect links the provider account to the authenticated initiating user.

redirect_uri.comment: Server-selected public provider callback URI; callers cannot supply or override it.

result_device_id.comment: Authenticated result device UUIDv7 allocated while the completion row is locked and reused by every issuance or replay.

result_kind.comment: Durable completion outcome: authenticated, MFA required, or connected.

result_session_id.comment: Authenticated result session UUIDv7 allocated while the completion row is locked and reused by every issuance or replay.

result_user_id.comment: Voucha user receiving the completion result; parent deletion cascades the authorization.

state_hash.comment: Purpose-bound HMAC-SHA256 of the provider state; plaintext state is returned once and never persisted.

status.comment: Explicit lifecycle: pending, callback_received, exchanging, completion_ready, completed, rejected, or expired.

x_user_id.comment: X account produced by a successful exchange; parent deletion cascades the authorization.

oauth_authorizations.comment: Durable server-begun OAuth state machine shared by web and native Facebook, X, and GitHub authentication and account connection.

approved_at.comment: Set when the current derived clearance status is approved.

ban_evasion_post_embedding_input_sha256.comment: Post embedding input SHA for which the post-embedding ban-evasion follow-up enqueue has been recorded.

broadcast.comment: Audience for this post: everyone, users, followers, or mutual_followers.

community_id.comment: Community scope for comments. NULL means global. FK to communities added in 0200-00-00-communities.sql.

creation_source_url_id.comment: Immutable raw URL submitted when creating a link post; NULL for existing URL records and rows written before immutable provenance.

data_point_vertical.comment: Discriminator for the structured data point schema (credit_card, bank_account). NULL for non-data-point posts.

in_review_at.comment: Set when the current derived clearance status is in_review.

post_type.comment: Discriminator: discussion, review, data_point, topic_recommendation, comment, story, link, article, or blog_post.

rejected_at.comment: Set when the current derived clearance status is rejected.

root_id.comment: Root post of a comment thread. NULL for top-level posts.

structured_data.comment: Structured JSONB payload for data point posts. Schema is determined by data_point_vertical.

title.comment: Post title (max 255 chars). At least one of title, markdown, or ai_summary_markdown must be non-empty.

url_id.comment: For link posts: the single external URL this post links. NULL for all other post types. Biconditional CHECK enforces mutual exclusivity.

votes_snapshot_xip_count.comment: Number of transactions still in progress in that vote-stat snapshot; lower is newer when the snapshot xmax is equal.

votes_snapshot_xmax.comment: Upper transaction-ID boundary of the PostgreSQL snapshot used for the persisted vote-stat aggregate.

posts.comment: User-generated posts: discussions, reviews, data points, recommendations, stories, and comments. RANGE-partitioned by id.

bounce_sub_type.comment: Detailed bounce sub-type from SES (e.g. General, NoEmail).

bounce_type.comment: Bounce classification: permanent, transient, or undetermined.

dedup_key.comment: SHA-256 hex digest of ses_message_id, notification_type, ses_timestamp, and the sorted normalized recipients; NULL when ses_message_id or ses_timestamp is missing. Absorbs at-least-once redelivery duplicates without collapsing distinct per-recipient notifications that share a mail.messageId and timestamp.

diagnostic_code.comment: SMTP diagnostic code from the bounce (e.g. 550 5.1.1).

notification_type.comment: SES notification type: bounce, complaint, or delivery.

raw_message.comment: Full raw SES notification payload for debugging.

recipients.comment: JSONB array of recipient email addresses affected by this event.

reporting_mta.comment: The MTA that reported the bounce.

ses_feedback_id.comment: SES feedback ID for the notification.

ses_message_id.comment: SES message ID for correlating with sent emails.

ses_timestamp.comment: Timestamp from the SES notification payload.

ses_bounce_events.comment: Records email bounce, complaint, and delivery notifications received from AWS SES.

landing_url.comment: The URL the referred session landed on (max 2048 chars).

signed_up_at.comment: When the referred session converted to a signup. NULL until the user registers.

user_id.comment: The user who signed up from this referral. NULL until signup or if user deletes account.

utm_campaign.comment: UTM campaign name from the referral URL.

utm_content.comment: UTM content parameter, used to differentiate links within the same campaign.

utm_medium.comment: UTM medium parameter from the referral URL (e.g. cpc, email).

utm_source.comment: UTM source parameter from the referral URL (e.g. google, newsletter).

session_referral_attributions.comment: Tracks which user referred a session, linking anonymous sessions to referrers for attribution. RANGE-partitioned by id with a default partition only; split later by adding explicit range partitions.

published_at.comment: When the event actually occurred (agent-determined, not row creation time).

title.comment: LLM-generated summary title for the story cluster.

batch_id.comment: Logical decision batch that produced this result.

candidate_id.comment: Stored story candidate scored by this result, or NULL for a runtime-prefiltered candidate.

candidate_kind.comment: Fixed story discriminator used only for the classifier-kind foreign key.

classifier_id.comment: Classifier copied from the owning batch for relational enforcement.

decision_call_id.comment: Specific provider call or shard that produced this result.

effective_lower_threshold.comment: Resolved lower boundary used for this immutable decision result.

effective_upper_threshold.comment: Resolved upper boundary used for this immutable decision result.

probability.comment: Native per-candidate probability preserved without threshold mapping.

prompt_version_id.comment: Prompt revision copied from the owning batch for relational enforcement.

raw_response.comment: Full native structured-decision answer for audit and diagnostics.

scope_category.comment: Decision scope copied from the owning batch.

scope_community_id.comment: Immutable community provenance copied from the owning batch.

story_id.comment: Story candidate scored by this result and the partition key.

threshold_id.comment: Exact stored-candidate threshold revision used, or NULL for a runtime-prefiltered candidate without stored configuration.

story_classifier_results.comment: Per-candidate classifier results for story candidates, RANGE-partitioned by story_id.

generation.comment: Monotonic source snapshot generation; stale workers cannot mutate a newer generation.

invalidation_completed_at.comment: Time the required story cache invalidation completed for this generation.

invalidation_required_at.comment: Time a committed relation mutation made the story cache invalidation due.

last_claimed_at.comment: Time the durable fairness marker was last updated, including retries after lease expiry.

lease_expires_at.comment: Deadline after which a different worker may claim the job.

lease_token.comment: Opaque fencing token rotated for each worker lease claim.

leased_at.comment: Time the current worker lease was claimed.

post_id.comment: Story post receiving the projected related URL relations.

prune_cursor_id.comment: Relation ID keyset cursor for the stale-relation pruning phase.

relation_high_water_id.comment: Relation ID high-water mark that excludes post-capture related links from this generation prune.

relation_snapshot_at.comment: Wall-clock boundary that excludes relations reactivated after this generation was captured.

source_completed_at.comment: Time the bounded source projection phase reached its high-water mark.

source_cursor_id.comment: RSS item ID keyset cursor for the bounded source projection phase.

source_high_water_id.comment: RSS item ID high-water mark that bounds this generation source snapshot.

story_id.comment: Current story whose active RSS item URLs are projected.

story_post_related_url_projection_jobs.comment: Durable, generation-fenced jobs that project one story snapshot onto each story post.

effects_dispatched_at.comment: Time the post-commit crawl dispatch completed.

eligible.comment: Whether pre-write safety screening admitted this URL for projection.

generation.comment: Projection generation that owns this receipt.

post_id.comment: Story post owning this projection receipt.

relation_written_at.comment: Time the related URL relation write committed.

source_item_id.comment: RSS feed item that supplied the candidate URL.

error.comment: Error details if the run failed.

input.comment: Thread context passed to the agent.

row_index.comment: Zero-based position of the input URL in the submitted import.

rss_feed_id.comment: RSS feed resolved or created for this row.

user_rss_feed_import_rows.comment: Individual RSS feed import URLs and per-row processing outcomes.

user_id.comment: Authenticated user who owns this idempotency key and exact import replay.

user_topic_import_attempts.comment: Bounded actor-owned exact response replays for topic-import batches; completed and abandoned attempts expire after 48 hours.

reason.comment: Internal reason for the warning (staff-visible only).

report_id.comment: The moderation report that triggered this warning, if any.

revoked_by_id.comment: The staff user who revoked this warning.

bad_faith_reporter_at.comment: Set when the user has an active report-abuse penalty; cleared when all penalties are revoked. Used by computeTrustTier to lower trust tier.

cards_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's cards.

community_memberships_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's community memberships.

country.comment: User preferred country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g., US).

default_post_broadcast.comment: Default audience setting for new posts.

default_post_privacy.comment: Default privacy setting for new posts.

direct_messages_audience.comment: Privacy: who can send this user direct messages.

engagement_emails_enabled.comment: Whether the user receives engagement recommendation emails.

fediverse_federation_enabled.comment: Per-user opt-in to ActivityPub federation (Phase C). Default FALSE; when TRUE, a public AP actor is exposed at /ap/users/:id and inbound follows are auto-accepted.

followers_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's followers.

follows_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see who this user follows (user follows).

hn_discussions.comment: When TRUE, related Hacker News threads are fetched for linked URLs on post and article pages.

individual_id.comment: The real-person individual linked to this user account for personal finance tracking.

is_system.comment: Marks a row as a system-owned account (e.g. jong admin, customer-support, autotagger). Reserved-username seed generators reclaim the username from any non-system holder before upserting here, and role/lookup gates require is_system = TRUE so a squatter can never inherit a system identity.

likes_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's likes.

markdown.comment: User profile bio in markdown format.

moderation_email_cadence.comment: Cadence for community moderation summary emails.

moderation_email_days_of_week.comment: Days of week for selected-day moderation email cadence, 1=Monday and 7=Sunday.

moderation_email_time_of_day.comment: Local HH:MM time for moderation summary emails.

moderation_email_timezone.comment: IANA timezone for moderation summary email scheduling.

moderation_emails_enabled.comment: Whether the user receives community moderation summary emails.

news_digest_frequency.comment: Frequency for first-party news digest emails.

pending_checkout_session_id.comment: Stripe Checkout Session that initiated the current identity-verification flow. Set when transitioning to identity_pending; cleared on terminal state. Used to recover checkout linkage when Stripe redacts VerificationSession metadata.

pending_verification_session_id.comment: Stores the Stripe Checkout Session ID during payment_pending, then the Stripe Identity VerificationSession ID during identity_pending; cleared on terminal state.

processing_restricted_at.comment: When data processing was restricted for this user (GDPR right to restrict processing). NULL means no restriction.

profile_image_id.comment: The user's profile image. NULL if no profile image is set.

public_verified_name_display.comment: How much of the legal name to show publicly.

referrer_id.comment: The user who referred this user, for referral attribution.

rewards_program_statuses_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's rewards program statuses.

rss_feed_follows_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's RSS feed follows.

spending_categories_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's spending categories.

third_party_marketing.comment: Marketing opt-in/out: TRUE=opted in, FALSE=opted out, NULL=not set.

topic_follows_visibility.comment: Privacy: who can see this user's topic follows.

ui_locale.comment: User preferred UI locale from supported UI message catalogs (e.g., en).

use_display_name_from.comment: Which source to use for the displayed name (username, facebook, x, etc.).

username.comment: Unique username chosen by the user. NULL if not yet set. Case-insensitive (stored lowercase).

verification_completed_at.comment: Timestamp when verification reached a terminal state (verified, failed, or duplicate_id).

verification_provider.comment: Provider used for verification, set once payment is initiated.

verification_status.comment: Current lifecycle state of the user's identity verification.

verified_badge_visible.comment: Whether to display the ID-verified badge on this user's public profile.

verified_first_name.comment: Verified legal first name, private unless user opts in.

verified_full_name.comment: Verified legal full name, private unless user opts in.

verified_last_name_initial.comment: Single initial of verified last name, private unless user opts in.

vote_weight.comment: Admin-set multiplier for this user's votes. Default 1.

vote_weight_admin_set_at.comment: When an admin last manually overrode this user's vote weight. NULL if never overridden.

vote_weight_recalculated_at.comment: When the vote weight was last recalculated automatically. NULL if never recalculated.

votes_snapshot_xip_count.comment: Number of transactions still in progress in that vote-stat snapshot; lower is newer when the snapshot xmax is equal.

votes_snapshot_xmax.comment: Upper transaction-ID boundary of the PostgreSQL snapshot used for the persisted vote-stat aggregate.

users.comment: User accounts. Core identity table for all registered users.
